 ORDER
The petitioners-accused Nos.1 to 5 are sought to be prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 324, 313 of IPC and sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. The case of the prosecution is that, the accused No.1, is the husband, accused Nos.2 and 3 are the parents-in- laws, accused Nos.4 and 5 are the sisters-in-laws and they subjected the defacto complainant to cruelty, both mentally and physically, and also a demand was made to bring money NC: 2023:KHC:29411 from her parental home, and also they have caused mis- carriage of the child without her consent.

sentences.text:
Parties are present before this Court with their respective counsels and have filed an application under Section 320(2) r/w Section 482 of Cr.P.C., for compounding of the offences, stating that,
parties have amicably settled the disputes among themselves, and the accused No.1 and the defacto complainant are leading a cordial marital life since then, and the complainant has no objection for quashing the impugned proceedings.
4. The said application is placed on record.
5. Punishment prescribed for offence under section 313 of IPC is punishable with imprisonment for a period of 10 years.

The charge sheet does not contain any material that the petitioners herein caused the mis-carriage of the child carried by the complainant herein, except the self serving statement of the complainant.

6. Though the offences alleged are cognizable and non-compoundable, however, having regard to the fact that, the parties have amicably settled the dispute among themselves, and complainant has reunited with her husband and leading a cordial marital life, it would be a futile exercise, if the petitioners-accused are subjected to trial, since the probability of their conviction is remote and bleak in view of the NC: 2023:KHC:29411 settlement arrived between them.
Hence, the continuation of criminal proceeding will be an abuse of process of law.

7. Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) The criminal petition is allowed;
ii) The impugned proceedings in S.C.No.315/2021, on the file of the Additional City Civil and Sessions Judge (CCH-72) at Bengaluru, insofar it relates to petitioners-accused Nos.1 to 5 stands quashed.
Sd/-
